_comment: factions.json - every faction of Aldenexia (canonical: ~/NCT/Aldenexia-Lightfall/Finalized Documents/Aldenexia_Player_Information_Updated.xlsx 'Factions' and Faction_Relationships_Final_Updated.txt, 2026-09-25). type 'player' = you have standing with it (starting standing base_standing, also in player_faction.json); 'monster' = the monster factions (always hostile for now). hostile_threshold: at or below it, that faction's monsters attack you on sight; friendly_threshold: at or above it they count you an ally. relations: a standing change with this faction also moves your standing with these by that share (allies +, rivals -), EverQuest style. Renamed 2026-09-25: Twilight Accord -> Tenebrae Obscurium, Echoes of the Deep -> Lirael's Concord, Umbral Talon -> The Moribund Order, Verdant Kin -> The Verdant Kin. type 'order' = a named order WITHIN another faction (parent): it shares the parent's standing — anything that changes or checks it uses the parent's. Circle of Thorns (The Verdant Kin), Hands of the Eternal Forge (Ironclad Brotherhood) and Arcane Dominion (Arcane Synod) became orders (user, 2026-09-25): the Pantheon map and the Vaelwyn / Brondrak Hold dialogue keep their names.

factions.name: Luminar Covenant
factions.description: The primary heroic faction opposing The Moribund Order. Seeks to preserve balance between light and shadow while protecting the Solstice Aegis; houses the Dawn Shard. Led by champions like Tenchijin and supported by Annadaeus.

factions.name: Wardens of the Sacred Flame
factions.description: Elite subfaction of the Luminar Covenant sworn to protect the Solstice Aegis. Based in Sanctum Pyraeth; the most zealous opponents of The Moribund Order. Paladins and clerics devoted to Aurethiel.

factions.name: The Moribund Order
factions.races: Ogres, Trolls, Lizardkin, Dark Elves, corrupted Half-Orcs
factions.description: The main antagonist faction (formerly the Umbral Talon), seeking to corrupt the Solstice Aegis and unleash the Lightfall. Necromancers, shadow knights and Void-touched cultists; True Believers and Useful Idiots. Led by figures like Zozuur Blackmaw and Freuda Iridusk.

factions.name: Tenebrae Obscurium
factions.description: The shadowy guild of rogues, assassins and shadow mages (formerly the Twilight Accord). Affiliated with Virexus; not inherently evil but works in moral grey. Shelters exiled enchanters and practitioners of the dark arts.

factions.name: Lirael's Concord
factions.description: Bards, diplomats and lore-keepers (formerly the Echoes of the Deep), making concord between fractured peoples. Led by Annadaeus Beidsdottir; serves Lirael and guards knowledge of the Aegis fragments.

factions.name: The Verdant Kin
factions.description: All Druids and Rangers protecting nature against civilization's encroachment. Guards an Aegis fragment in Thornspire Glade. Worships Thalorun, some Elyndra.

factions.name: Arcane Synod
factions.description: Scholars who believe magic should be studied, catalogued and controlled; research halls in Grebblewick and Starreach. Rivals of The Verdant Kin; exiled the enchanters and necromancers after the Chronoglass Incident.

factions.name: Ironclad Brotherhood
factions.description: A disciplined mercenary company of honour-bound contracts and martial prowess; trains in Brondrak Hold and Ironfist Hold.

factions.name: Order of the Silent Fist
factions.races: Half-Orcs, Humans, Monks of all races
factions.description: A monastic order seeking enlightenment through restraint and discipline, based in Ironfist Hold's Silent Temple.

factions.name: Celestial Weavers
factions.description: Spiritual guides and divine healers drawing on celestial and elemental power; healing sanctuaries in Brondrak Hold and other sacred sites.

factions.name: Guild of the Eclipsed Mind
factions.description: Gnomish tinkerers and dark elf illusionists studying forbidden magic, formed by the Pact of the Veil; heretics to the Arcane Synod, useful to The Moribund Order.

factions.name: Villagers of Lumora
factions.description: The common folk of Lumora, caught between the Covenant's ideals and the Order's schemes: farmers, merchants and craftspeople.

factions.name: Stoneblood Clan
factions.description: Troll shamans within The Moribund Order practising necrotic rites in Veyra's Hollow; serve Morthan. Led by Zozuur Blackmaw.

factions.name: Brood of Fennarach
factions.description: The lizardkin warrior caste serving The Moribund Order through Kaerun, in the Sauros Reach district of Veyra's Hollow.

factions.name: Shattered Horn Tribe
factions.description: Brutal ogre clans of Thalden's Reach who worship Kaerun and serve The Moribund Order for the battles.

factions.name: Veilstriders
factions.description: Dark elves who walk between worlds studying the Veil itself; based in Shadowfen alongside The Moribund Order and the Tenebrae Obscurium.

factions.name: Covenant of the Dark Kris
factions.races: Dark Elves, assassins of many races
factions.description: A secretive network of contract killers and political assassins, close to the Tenebrae Obscurium.

factions.name: Djhanid Clans
factions.description: The desert-born nomads of the dunes: wary of outsiders, who mistake them for the Dustwalker bandits. Kill or mistreat them and they attack on sight; treat them well and they become allies (The Djhanid.txt).

factions.name: Circle of Thorns
factions.description: The druid order within The Verdant Kin, born of the Second Bloom; sworn to Thalorun and Elyndra, keepers of Vaelwyn's groves.

factions.name: Hands of the Eternal Forge
factions.description: Durnhal's forge-priests of Brondrak Hold, the Ironclad Brotherhood's temple: they bless the steel the Brotherhood carries.

factions.name: Arcane Dominion
factions.description: The Arcane Synod's hardline wing, who hold that magic is for ruling; followers of Nyssara and Sylaen.

factions.name: The Hollow Crown
factions.description: Once rulers of great kingdoms, these undead aristocrats cling to their former glory, commanding legions of spectral knights and cursed retainers.

factions.name: Graveblight Swarm
factions.description: A mindless horde of decaying corpses and ravenous ghouls, driven by necromantic will or primal hunger, spreading corruption wherever they roam.

factions.name: Whispers of the Hollow
factions.description: Ethereal undead who whisper secrets of the netherworld, seeking forbidden knowledge and dominion over the veil between life and death.

factions.name: Stoneheart Collective
factions.description: Ancient guardians of sacred sites and forgotten ruins, animated by elemental magic and bound to eternal duty.

factions.name: Stormbinders of Mael'Thun
factions.description: Servants of a forgotten storm god who command the skies with thunder and wind, often appearing as omens of change.

factions.name: Glare of Zetherin
factions.description: Beings of radiant energy and crystalline form, revered by some as divine messengers or avatars of celestial order.

factions.name: Shardscale Brood
factions.description: A proud and ancient draconic lineage seeking to reclaim dominion over the skies and hoard the world's arcane treasures.

factions.name: Lunaborne Conclave
factions.description: Bound by blood and moonlight, primal beings walking the line between man and beast in secretive packs with their own laws.

factions.name: Ashenborn Pact
factions.description: Fiends from charred realms beyond the veil, breaching into Aldenexia through scorched gateways to spread chaos and corruption.

factions.name: The Verdant Maw
factions.description: Twisted remnants of once-pure nature that seek to reclaim the world through overgrowth, decay and predation.
